We use the symmetric and antisymmetric combinations of the rates,
\begin{equation}
\Gamma_\pm \equiv \Gamma_L \pm \Gamma_R .
\label{eq:gpm}
\end{equation}
so that
\begin{equation}
\Gamma_+ + \Gamma_- = 2\Gamma_L .
\label{eq:sum}
\end{equation}
